source: 按触发条件启动
en: Trigger start

source: 按需加载
en: On-demand loading

source: 保留原始命令、环境变量、值名称及注册表值类型；禁用只移除此值，恢复时不会覆盖已有值。
en: Preserves the original command, environment variables, value name and registry type. Disabling removes only this value; restoring never overwrites an existing value.

source: 部分服务或驱动未能读取：
en: Some services or drivers could not be read:

source: 部分计划任务未能读取：
en: Some scheduled tasks could not be read:

source: 部分启动文件夹未能读取：
en: Some startup folders could not be read:

source: 部分任务目录未能读取：
en: Some task folders could not be read:

source: 部分注册表启动项未能读取：
en: Some registry startup entries could not be read:

source: 部分自启动来源未能读取：
en: Some startup sources could not be read:

source: 此来源不支持修改。
en: Changes are not supported for this source.

source: 此路径含重解析点，不能安全修改。
en: This path contains a reparse point and cannot be changed safely.

source: 此入口仅供查看，未修改任何配置。
en: This entry is view only. No configuration was changed.

source: 此入口由组策略管理，仅供查看。
en: Managed by Group Policy; view only.

source: 当前用户
en: Current user

source: 服务触发配置超过读取上限。
en: The service trigger configuration exceeds the read limit.

source: 服务的程序身份或其他配置已变化，未修改启动方式。
en: The service identity or another setting changed. Its startup type was not changed.

source: 服务配置无法完整核实：
en: The service configuration could not be fully verified:

source: 会话状态变化
en: Session state change

source: 计划任务达到数量或目录上限，部分任务未读取。
en: The task or folder count limit was reached. Some tasks were not read.

source: 计划任务定义超过读取上限。
en: The task definition exceeds the read limit.

source: 计划任务已变化或属于系统任务。
en: The scheduled task has changed or is a system task.

source: 计划任务状态无法核实，未修改配置。
en: The task state could not be verified. No configuration was changed.

source: 仅显示当前权限下可读取的来源；未加载的用户配置及部分系统扩展不在范围内。启用状态表示该来源的配置状态，启动审批、策略、触发条件仍可能阻止运行。
en: Shows sources readable with current permissions. Unloaded user profiles and some system extensions are outside this scan. Enabled describes the source configuration; startup approval, policy or trigger conditions may still prevent it from running.

source: 空闲
en: Idle

source: 没有本程序保存的原始启动方式，暂不恢复。
en: The original startup type was not saved by this app, so it cannot be restored.

source: 没有与当前禁用状态相符的原始备份，不能猜测恢复配置。
en: No original backup matches the current disabled state. Restoration settings will not be guessed.

source: 某个注册表启动来源超过读取上限，已跳过。
en: A registry startup source exceeded the read limit and was skipped.

source: 配置未改变。
en: The configuration was not changed.

source: 其他用户的登录配置，仅供查看。
en: Another user's logon configuration; view only.

source: 启动文件超过可恢复管理的大小上限，只能查看。
en: This startup file exceeds the size limit for reversible changes; view only.

source: 驱动影响系统启动，仅供查看。
en: Drivers affect system startup; view only.

source: 任务注册
en: Task registration

source: 日历计划
en: Calendar schedule

source: 入口已发生变化，请刷新列表后重新确认。
en: The entry has changed. Refresh the list and confirm again.

source: 入口已经处于所选状态。
en: The entry is already in the selected state.

source: 入口在备份期间发生变化，已取消修改。
en: The entry changed while its backup was being saved. The change was canceled.

source: 所有用户
en: All users

source: 未配置触发器，可由其他程序调用
en: No trigger configured; other programs can invoke this task

source: 未完成自启动配置修改：
en: The startup configuration change could not be completed:

source: 文件不在已核实的启动文件夹内。
en: The file is outside the verified startup folders.

source: 无法核实入口当前已启用，未修改配置。
en: The entry could not be verified as enabled. No configuration was changed.

source: 无法生成可恢复的禁用方案。
en: A reversible disable operation could not be prepared.

source: 系统
en: System

source: 系统登录组件，仅供查看。
en: System logon component; view only.

source: 系统服务或身份未能充分核实，仅供查看。
en: System service or identity not fully verified; view only.

source: 系统或只读入口不能修改。
en: System or view-only entries cannot be changed.

source: 系统计划任务，仅供查看。
en: System scheduled task; view only.

source: 系统加载
en: System loading

source: 系统启动
en: System startup

source: 系统事件
en: System event

source: 下次登录时运行一次
en: Runs once at the next logon

source: 修改后状态与预期不符，请刷新检查；原始备份已保留，未覆盖其他更改。
en: The resulting state differs from the expected state. Refresh and inspect it. The original backup is retained; other changes were not overwritten.

source: 已恢复原始自启动配置；不会立即运行程序。
en: The original startup configuration was restored. The program will not be started now.

source: 已启用计划任务；不会立即运行任务。
en: The scheduled task was enabled. It will not be run now.

source: 已禁用此入口；当前运行的程序或服务不会被停止。
en: This entry was disabled. A currently running program or service will not be stopped.

source: 引导加载
en: Boot loading

source: 用户登录
en: User logon

source: 由 Process Keeper 禁用；保留了可核对的原始配置备份。
en: Disabled by Process Keeper; an original configuration backup is available for verification.

source: 原始注册表项已不存在。
en: The original registry key no longer exists.

source: 原位置已有文件，未覆盖。
en: A file already occupies the original location. It was not overwritten.

source: 只读取启动文件；禁用前保存文件内容、时间、属性及访问权限，不解析迁移链接或运行目标。
en: Reads startup files only. Content, timestamps, attributes and permissions are saved before disabling. Moved shortcut targets are not resolved and no target is run.

source: 只改变任务的启用标记；不会运行、停止或重新注册任务。计划任务可能由登录、开机、时间或其他事件触发。
en: Changes only the task's enabled flag; never runs, stops or re-registers it. Tasks may be triggered by logon, boot, time or other events.

source: 只修改服务启动方式，不启动或停止服务。恢复保留原始自动、延迟与触发配置；驱动和受保护服务不修改。
en: Changes only the service startup type, without starting or stopping it. Restoration preserves the original automatic, delayed and trigger settings. Drivers and protected services cannot be changed.

source: 指定时间
en: Scheduled time

source: 注册表入口不在允许修改的范围内。
en: The registry entry is outside the allowed change scope.

source: 注册表值类型不受支持。
en: The registry value type is not supported.

source: 注册表值类型或长度不受支持，只能查看。
en: The registry value type or length is unsupported; view only.

source: 自动（延迟启动）
en: Automatic (delayed start)

source: 自动启动
en: Automatic start

source: 自启动备份标识无效。
en: The startup backup identifier is invalid.

source: 自启动备份超过大小上限。
en: The startup backup exceeds the size limit.

source: 自启动备份的身份或状态不匹配。
en: The startup backup identity or state does not match.

source: 自启动备份未能完整读取：
en: Startup backups could not be fully read:

source: 自启动备份无法读取。
en: The startup backup could not be read.

source: 自启动入口身份不完整。
en: The startup entry identity is incomplete.

source: COM 或其他任务动作
en: COM or other task action

source: Windows 启动审批已禁用此入口；请在 Windows 启动应用设置中调整。
en: Windows startup approval has disabled this entry. Change it in Windows Startup Apps settings.

source: Windows 启动审批状态无法识别，仅供查看。
en: The Windows startup approval state is unknown; view only.

source: 扫描达到 {0} 项或 {1} 秒上限。正在执行的系统读取可能稍后返回。
en: The scan reached its limit of {0} entries or {1} seconds. A system read already in progress may return later.
